decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper shares engineering, parts and service with the core dumper range, so holding the option is cheap while its market value is still resolving.
The articulated dumper extends the core construction offer at low holding cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.

Mine rescue vehicles have long, niche procurement cycles, so two years reveal too little to abandon a product that uses the firm's underground expertise, though its distance from the core keeps the risk higher.
The multi-model telescopic loader line is close to the core business and holds several growth options at modest cost.
The material lift line has a long rental track record and a new large order, so its value is largely confirmed and further commitment is justified.
1,000 operating hours in seven months show positive early field evidence for the mining loader, which supports keeping the option open despite its distance from the core offer.
